name: praxis-thread-share
description: Publish the current real Praxis conversation to a private GitHub-backed thread repository.

interface.longDescription: Publishes the real conversation into a team room under the current GitHub project, redacts sensitive values, updates the thread index, and commits and pushes through the user's configured Git credentials.

commands.name: share
commands.description: Publish the current Praxis thread to a team room. Usage: /share <team>.
